items.title: Pullback along the comparison from the pro-etale to the etale site is an equivalence on locally constant sheaves of finite presentation
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a scheme X and a ring Lambda the pullback along the comparison morphism defines an equivalence between the locally constant sheaves of Lambda-modules of finite presentation on the etale site and on the pro-etale site (statement lines 4337-4358). The proof (proof lines 4360-4388) trivializes the sheaf on a pro-etale covering, splits the base into disjoint open pieces by the openness of images of fpqc coverings, forms the torsor of isomorphisms with a constant sheaf, and concludes by the agreement of torsors for the two topologies. H2: a three-step argument with three inputs, written out in full.
